name: Lightwell Demo — Block Known CVEs
description: Blocks images containing specific CVEs targeted by this demo: Woodstox DoS, JsonPath recursion, org.json DoS, and Spring Core data binding bypass.
rationale: These CVEs represent denial-of-service and authorization bypass vulnerabilities that must be blocked at build and deploy time.
remediation: Replace affected dependencies with Lightwell Network remediated versions (e.g., woodstox-core:6.0.3.rhlw-00001).
